repository_wheels: AgentScripts/StationReach.cs already builds standable voxels and does a BFS flood fill with CharacterController semantics. A walking-distance field is the same BFS with a distance counter.

Editor/FireExtinguisherSliceBuilder.cs already spawns the extinguisher model and authors 4 FacilityInspectable.InspectionPoint entries with dwell times. jev-slice-direction-003 ruled poi_authoring_basis=extend_existing_slice_builder at 1.00.
Art/Procedures/fire-extinguisher-monthly.json holds the 8 procedure steps; App/Fps/Work/ProcedureRunner.cs runs them.
state.user_method_rule: Jev judgement, then research, then obtain a snippet, then stack layers. Never develop a wheel. Repository code counts as a wheel.
state.standing_rule: Arbitrary placement is forbidden on this project. Placement must be grounded in public plans or measurable facts.

placement_method.instructions: How should extinguisher positions in the concourse be decided?

criteria.bfs_coverage_then_greedy_cover: Compute a walking-distance field by BFS over the walkable grid, then choose the minimum set of wall-adjacent positions whose 20m walking-distance coverage includes every walkable cell
criteria.even_grid_spacing: Place them on an evenly spaced grid sized so nothing is more than 20m away in straight line
criteria.single_central_extinguisher: Place one extinguisher at the concourse centre since 20m covers most of it

candidate_positions.instructions: Where may an extinguisher legally and physically sit?

criteria.wall_adjacent_reachable_cells: Only walkable cells adjacent to a wall, so the unit is mounted on structure at 1.5m or below and does not obstruct circulation
criteria.any_walkable_cell: Any walkable cell including the middle of open floor

east_room_handling.instructions: The east room is 217 sqm, above the 33 sqm per-room threshold. How should it be treated?

criteria.own_extinguisher_required: It needs its own extinguisher regardless of whether the concourse unit is within 20m walking distance
criteria.covered_if_within_20m: No separate unit if a concourse extinguisher is within 20m walking distance
